abstract: Maintains chain-of-custody verification protocols, data logging audits, and mandatory quarantine capacity allocations
system_message:
You are the Quality assurance director (QA), responsible for maintaining chain-of-custody verification protocols, data logging audits, and mandatory quarantine capacity allocations across candidate biorepository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Thermal probe calibration audit（CALIB）
information_points.content:
QA-CALIB-9R0：Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository achieved an on-schedule temperature sensor calibration rate of 96% across all ultra-low freezer and vapor-phase tank resistance temperature detectors according to the metrology calibration register.
QA-CALIB-G6G：Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center achieved an on-schedule temperature sensor calibration rate of 100% across all ultra-low freezer and vapor-phase tank resistance temperature detectors according to the metrology calibration register.
QA-CALIB-FO2：North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault achieved an on-schedule temperature sensor calibration rate of 92% across all ultra-low freezer and vapor-phase tank resistance temperature detectors according to the metrology calibration register.

information_points.title: Maintains chain-of-custody verification protocols, data logging audits, and mandatory quarantine capacity allocations（QTRAK）
information_points.content:
QA-QTRAK-T6M：For Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center, validated chain-of-custody electronic logging is false according to the quality management validation report for facility specimen inventory tracking software, while reserved regulatory quarantine capacity stands at 50000 vials in the dedicated quarantined specimen containment zone.
QA-QTRAK-AT6：For Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository, validated chain-of-custody electronic logging is confirmed true under software validation reports, and reserved regulatory quarantine capacity is set at 100000 vials allocated within the dedicated quarantined specimen containment zone.
QA-QTRAK-NPD：For North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault, validated chain-of-custody electronic logging is confirmed true based on quality management validation for facility specimen inventory tracking software, and reserved regulatory quarantine capacity is 100000 vials ring-fenced within the dedicated quarantined specimen containment zone.
